title: Ui/Ux Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level

About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.

This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.

What You'll Do

- Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

- Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

- Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

- Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

- Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

- Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

- Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

- 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

- Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

- Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

- Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

- Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

- Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined

Nice to Have

- Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

- Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

- Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

- Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up

How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.

We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.

What You'll Get

- Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

- Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

- A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Analista Processos Regulatorios Jr
description:

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL;
DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:

\ "We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

DevOps

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Linux systems administration
  • Networking fundamentals

Automation

Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.

Languages

Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.

Why work with Quave

We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • 22 days paid time off per year
  • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
  • AI allowance for productivity tools

We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

Hiring Process

  • Application review
  • Technical conversation
  • Architecture discussion
  • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
  • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: .Net Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We're privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word 'partner' over 'vendor', and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.

A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
    entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
    domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência comframeworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ouexperiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeMental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeFísica - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI's and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.

As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.

About iCore

iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.

Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.

Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.

Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.

Objectives:

  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns

Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.G., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments

Benefits:

Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.

  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.

  • Work with a mission-driven team

You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.

  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.

  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.

  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.

Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.

  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.

  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.

  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.

  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.

What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position

You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What's in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

Our approach

We focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Quality Assurance (Qa) — Funcional / Manual
description:

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.

We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.

In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.

Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?

Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible

Key Responsibilities

Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.

Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.

Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.

Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.

Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.

Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.

Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.G., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Benefits

  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.

We believe in hiring talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, not only because we should do it but because fresh perspectives improve our team and our decisions. Our multicultural team is made up of young, energetic, and positive people who are passionate about what they do.

As part of our team, you'll reflect the people we serve and will have the opportunity to work with thousands and impact millions of lives around the world.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.

FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.

We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.

What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.Js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.

Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team

You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.Js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome

Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience

Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction

Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil

How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Starrocks Database Engineer (Dbe) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‐source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‐critical, high‐volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We're a small, world-class expert, remote‐first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You'll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.

While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage;
    no PoCs)
  • Provenexperience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines.
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a\ "bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you'll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional\ "human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you'll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Professor De Francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Consultor De Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog, estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog.
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.

Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What's in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

Our approach

We focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com

The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.

In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.

As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.

Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.

Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.

Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts

Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines

Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Purpose of This Position

As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.

You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.

Core Responsibility

Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"
  • \ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"

Main Objectives

1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.

2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics

3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.

4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.

5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.

Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.

2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.

3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
    partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable businessteams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
    contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience withETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience withSiebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Java Com Angular
description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!
