Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde;

Seguro de Vida;

Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Analista Processos Regulatorios Jr
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.

Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.

Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Realizar o monitoramento e atualização de controles em Excel, garantindo a organização e confiabilidade das informações.

- Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.

- Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.

- Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.

- Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.

- Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.

- Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.

- Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.

Requisitos e qualificações

- Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.

- Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).

- Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.

- Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Professor De Francês
description:

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Starrocks Database Engineer (Dbe) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‐source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‐critical, high‐volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We're a small, world-class expert, remote‐first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You'll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.

While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage;
    no PoCs)
  • Provenexperience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines.
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.

About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
    experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
    Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

title: Founding Qa / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, Ai + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We're a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.

We're rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.

Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.

We're building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.

Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we're now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.

We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.

We're looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.

This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.

The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires

What You'll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale

Who Are You?

- You've tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You've built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss

Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems

Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments

Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don't care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.

Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration

Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person

Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.

Why Join Now?

You'd be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome

If you're hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren't many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.

The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project.   • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from

This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. Responsibilities and Accountabilities

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Purpose of This Position

As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.

You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.

Core Responsibility

Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"
  • \ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"

Main Objectives

1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.

2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics

3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.

4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.

5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.

Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.

2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.

3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.

You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.

This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.

What You'll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines

If you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: L3 Support Services Appendix Redhat
description:

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.'

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:

● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.G., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

Visual & Brand Experience Designer

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.

You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment.   • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines

If you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

We're rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.

Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.

We're building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.

Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we're now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.

We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.

This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.

The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires

What You'll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale

Who Are You?

- You've tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You've built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss

Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems

Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments

Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don't care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.

Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration

Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person

Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.

Why Join Now?

You'd be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome

If you're hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren't many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts

Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines

Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world's leading cross-border platforms – and we're just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.

Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.

WHAT'S THE CHALLENGE?

You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You'll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You've got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.

WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH

You'll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You'll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can't imagine working in any other way, and it's the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders

PingPong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

  • We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.

You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.G., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.

Strategic Importance

  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it's about impact and influence across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.

Promotion & Trade Effectiveness

  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.

Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy

  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.

Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:

  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk

Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support

  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.

Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.

Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:

  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations

Executive Storytelling & Data Communication

  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.

Proven track record with:

  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks

Capabilities

  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Analista De Sistemas Sr Analytics Engineer - Databricks
description:

title: Freebsd Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.

This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.G., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.

Responsabilidades

KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.

  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.

  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.

Diferenciais valorizados

  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
    postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
    fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Sap S/4 Hana Brim Application Expert
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.

PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.

KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.

SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline

Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Professor De Inglês
description:

title: It Risk Management Lead

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
    entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
    domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência comframeworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ouexperiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeMental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeFísica - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.

The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.

What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety

What we're looking for

  • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate

title: Support Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development. You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform.

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes. You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.

Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.

  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.
