Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines. Compensation
Salary: based on your experience level

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.
If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.
This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.
The impact you'll make:
Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence Technology Stack:
Go (Golang)
Blockchain What you'll bring to us:
5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, Ed DSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy working with us:
The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto
---
ATENÇÃO — Como se candidatar
Não aceitamos candidaturas por aqui.
As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.
Candidate-se agora:
Leva cerca de 15 minutos. Você sabe na hora se avança.
---

title: Sap technical lead
description:

Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. 420+ global clients across the U. S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
Millions of users engaged monthly
150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times Searching for your dream job? Company Description
Sofia Health is a U. S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.
We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, Linked In, social media, and podcast channels.

The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.
This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.

title: Contract clinical research associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)
Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.
About Clinergy
Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.
Role Description
We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.
Activities
Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
Verify the accuracy of study results;
Identify and resolve site issues; Requirements
Bachelor's degree in life sciences;
2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
Advanced/Fluent in English;
Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices Skills
Self driven individual
Sense of urgency
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Good problem solving skills
Enthusiastic and energetic To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to
Note: Candidates who do not possess the mandatory requirements specified above will not be considered.

title: Software engineer sênior - vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso " Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.
Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!
About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.
We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications:
Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience:
Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:
Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms. Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Risk control analyst
description:
Job Responsibilities
Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, including fraud, phishing, and account theft, and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction.
Continuously monitor user behavior and prepare investigation reports for identified risk cases.

Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions. Requirements

Data analysis experience is a plus.
Strong communication and written skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
Strong logical thinking and analytical ability, capable of breaking down complex data.
Fluency in Chinese is required.

You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You'll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You've got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.

You'll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You'll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.

Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next. WHAT YOU BRING
Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams. WHO YOU ARE
Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
Customer-focused, you can't imagine working in any other way, and it's the only way to achieve our goals.
Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders Ping Pong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.

Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. title: Pessoa gerente financeira
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real.
Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área:
Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional.
Faturamento (Billing):
Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (Saa S/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos.
Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência:
Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa.
Contas a Pagar (AP) e Tesouraria:
Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros.
Compras e Gestão de Custos:
Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores.
Controles Internos e Compliance:
Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos.
Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria:
Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica.
Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência:
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.

Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets). Também é legal se você tiver:
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em empresas Saa S ou modelos de receita recorrente;
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de Saa S (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Contract clinical research associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)
Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.
About Clinergy
Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.
Role Description
We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.
Activities
Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
Verify the accuracy of study results;
Identify and resolve site issues; Requirements
Bachelor's degree in life sciences;
2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
Advanced/Fluent in English;
Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices Skills
Self driven individual
Sense of urgency
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Good problem solving skills
Enthusiastic and energetic To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to
Note: Candidates who do not possess the mandatory requirements specified above will not be considered.

Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;

Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais). O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass

title: Media buyer
description:
Senior Media Buyer – Home Renovation / Roofing (Video-First)
Location
Remote
Full-time
About Us
We're a lean, A1 performance marketing team serving 30+ roofing contractors across the U. S., and we're scaling aggressively to 100+ clients.
No bloated layers. No politics. No babysitting.
We specialize in video-driven paid media systems that generate booked appointments and signed jobs for roofing and home renovation businesses. If you don't understand contractors, sales cycles, and how to turn ads into revenue — this is not the role for you.
If you do — you'll have autonomy, trust, and real impact.
The Role (Read Carefully)
We're hiring a Senior Media Buyer who can own campaign execution end-to-end for roofing and home renovation clients.
This is not a "strategy-only" role.
This is not a "just launch ads and wait" role.
You will:
Set up
Launch
Optimize
Scale Video-first paid media systems across TOF / MOF / BOF.
You must understand how contractors think, how homeowners buy, and how to turn attention into booked jobs.
Core Responsibilities
1. Campaign Setup & Launch
Build and launch Meta (Facebook/Instagram) video campaigns for roofing & home renovation clients
Structure accounts cleanly (TOF / MOF / BOF separation)
Implement proper tracking, events, and reporting
QA everything before launch — no sloppy work 2. Funnel Ownership (TOF → MOF → BOF)
You must know how to:
Run TOF video ads for awareness and demand creation
Build MOF retargeting (video views, engagement, site traffic)
Execute BOF conversion campaigns (lead forms, landing pages, booked calls)
Diagnose where funnels break and fix them fast 3. Video Ad Performance Optimization
Analyze hooks, angles, creatives, and messaging
Kill losers fast, scale winners responsibly
Give clear feedback on what video content is needed to improve results
Understand what works specifically in roofing & home renovation 4. Client Readiness & Professional Conduct
You don't talk like a marketer — you talk like a business operator
Campaign updates are clear, calm, and confident
You understand contractor economics (job size, close rates, seasonality)
You protect the agency's reputation at all times Required Experience (Non-Negotiable)
You must have:
3+ years managing paid social campaigns
Direct experience in home renovation or roofing marketing
Proven results using video ads (Meta primarily)
Experience running full-funnel paid media systems
Strong understanding of lead quality, not just CPL
Ability to work independently without hand-holding If you've never marketed roofing, remodeling, windows, HVAC, solar, or similar trades — don't apply.
Who You Are
Tactical, fast, and detail-oriented
Calm under pressure
Takes ownership and responsibility
Doesn't make excuses — fixes problems
Understands that performance > opinions
Wants to grow with a team scaling hard This Role Is NOT For You If:
You need constant direction
You blame platforms instead of fixing campaigns
You don't understand contractors or local service businesses
You want a "chill" role instead of a high-performance one Compensation
Competitive base pay (based on experience)
Performance-based growth opportunities
Long-term role as we scale to 100+ clients
High performers will be rewarded. Period.

Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas O que nós estamos procurando:
Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações O que oferecemos:
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso " Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Data consultant brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing
As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.
Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team's evolution.
Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
Participate in Training: You'll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team. What we are looking for
Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
Interest in Data and Business: Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
Analytical and Practical Mindset: Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem: Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit: You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team. What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our " Get Together" where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing
Progress: every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!

title: Especialista de operações (operations specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:
Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets. Requirements:
3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus. What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry. Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus
Job type: Full Time
Responsabilidades:
Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat) e stablecoins, bem como atividades de VASP.
Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados. Requisitos:
Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial. O que oferecemos:
Salário e benefícios competitivos.
Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria. Qualificações Preferenciais:
Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial. Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral
Termos Técnicos: Mantive termos como Stablecoin, VASP, OTC, SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
Adaptação Cultural: O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.

title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development
Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.
Location: Brazil
The Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M& A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M& A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.
The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M& A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.
Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M& A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M& A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M& A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M& A leadership to qualify M& A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units. Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M& A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M& A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency. Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Summary
We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.
Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.
This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.
Responsibilities
Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance Qualifications
2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier What We Offer
Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role
Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.
Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!
Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:
O Grupo Capital:
Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.
Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.
Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.
Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital:
A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.
Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.
Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.
Responsabilidades:
Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. Pré-requisitos:
Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
Proatividade orientada a resultados;
Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Diferencial:
Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas. Você terá:
Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
Programa de partnership estruturado;
Treinamentos exclusivos;
Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente. Modo de contratação:
Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Wordpress plugin & full stack developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.
Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?
Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution: Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.
Defect Management: Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
Collaboration: Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.
Automation: Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines. Compensation
Salary: based on your experience level
To Apply Submit:
Current resume
Synopsis of recent salary history
If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview Requirements Before Employment
Signed Confidentiality agreement
Signed Non-compete agreement
Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form Company Culture
Remote
We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
Hours 8 AM - 5 PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

description:

title: Full-time social ads specialist
description:
About Us
Blue Tuskr is a U. S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.
What You'll Do
As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.
Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to Linked In, Pinterest, and Tik Tok.
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.
This role requires a strong understanding of post-i OS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.
More specifically, in this role you will:
Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates What We're Looking For
4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships What This Role Is NOT
This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.
Time Commitment
Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.
Pay
$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.
If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!
